SELECT year AS __timestamp, country_name AS country_name, sum(SP_POP_TOTL) AS `sum__SP_POP_TOTL` 
FROM examples.wb_health_population INNER JOIN (SELECT country_name AS country_name__, sum(SP_POP_TOTL) AS mme_inner__ 
FROM examples.wb_health_population 
WHERE year >= STR_TO_DATE('1960-01-01 00:00:00.000000', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AND year < STR_TO_DATE('2014-01-02 00:00:00.000000', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') GROUP BY country_name ORDER BY mme_inner__ DESC 
 LIMIT 25) AS series_limit ON country_name = country_name__ 
WHERE year >= STR_TO_DATE('1960-01-01 00:00:00.000000', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AND year < STR_TO_DATE('2014-01-02 00:00:00.000000', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') GROUP BY country_name, year ORDER BY `sum__SP_POP_TOTL` DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT region AS region, sum(SP_POP_TOTL) AS `sum__SP_POP_TOTL`, sum(SP_RUR_TOTL_ZS) AS `sum__SP_RUR_TOTL_ZS`, sum(SP_DYN_LE00_IN) AS `sum__SP_DYN_LE00_IN` 
FROM examples.wb_health_population 
WHERE year >= STR_TO_DATE('2011-01-01 00:00:00.000000', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AND year < STR_TO_DATE('2011-01-02 00:00:00.000000', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AND (country_code NOT IN ('TCA', 'MNP', 'DMA', 'MHL', 'MCO', 'SXM', 'CYM', 'TUV', 'IMY', 'KNA', 'ASM', 'ADO', 'AMA', 'PLW')) GROUP BY region
